issues.explanation: Chapter 60 already states that Liu Bei and Liu Zhang meet at 涪城 and finish a banquet before returning to their camps. Chapter 61 repeats their arrival, meeting, and an initial banquet before proceeding to the next day's attempted assassination. This duplicates the preceding scene and makes the banquet sequence slightly confusing.
issues.suggested_fix: Begin Chapter 61 with the second-day banquet, e.g. “第二天，刘备又与刘璋宴饮……” and retain the sword-dance attempt; or remove the earlier meeting-and-banquet summary from Chapter 60.
